mapper.insert: INSERT INTO beneficiary ( customer_id, beneficiary_account_id, beneficiary_name, nickname, beneficiary_status ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{beneficiaryAccountId}, #{beneficiaryName}, #{nickname}, #{beneficiaryStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT beneficiary_id, customer_id, beneficiary_account_id, beneficiary_name, nickname, beneficiary_status, created_at, updated_at FROM beneficiary WHERE beneficiary_id = #{beneficiaryId}

SELECT beneficiary_id, customer_id, beneficiary_account_id, beneficiary_name, nickname, beneficiary_status, created_at, updated_at FROM beneficiary WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT beneficiary_id, customer_id, beneficiary_account_id, beneficiary_name, nickname, beneficiary_status, created_at, updated_at FROM beneficiary WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND beneficiary_account_id = #{beneficiaryAccountId}
SELECT beneficiary_id, customer_id, beneficiary_account_id, beneficiary_name, nickname, beneficiary_status, created_at, updated_at FROM beneficiary ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE beneficiary SET nickname = #{nickname}, beneficiary_status = #{beneficiaryStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE beneficiary_id = #{beneficiaryId}
UPDATE beneficiary SET beneficiary_status = 'INACTIVE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE beneficiary_id = #{beneficiaryId}
